# ZeeKay Editz

> ZeeKay Editz is a premium video editing and motion design studio serving YouTube creators and brands in the US, UK, and EU. Founded by Zahid Ali (Zeekay). The studio specializes in style-matched editing — replicating and executing recognizable YouTube editing styles (Pexto, Ryan Pictures, iceberg explainers, true crime, VSL/direct-response) with After Effects motion graphics and retention-focused Premiere Pro editing.

Pricing: Signature After Effects edits up to $400 per 15-minute video (custom animations, kinetic typography, cinematic sound design). Growth long-form edits in Premiere Pro from $60 per video up to 10 minutes (volume rate for cashcow and high-upload channels). Every new client receives a free 1-minute sample edit of their own footage before paying anything. Remote-first, worldwide, US/UK/EU friendly hours. Contact: https://zeekayeditz.com/#contact

## Editing Style Pages

- [Pexto Style Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/pexto-style-video-editing.html): How the studio replicates Pexto's fast-paced style — beat-locked cuts, zoom hierarchy, meme timing, SFX layering — with client samples.
- [Ryan Pictures Style Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/ryan-pictures-style-video-editing.html): Documentary-grade Ryan Pictures style editing with cinematic pacing and motion design, with samples.
- [Iceberg Style Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/iceberg-style-video-editing.html): Iceberg explainer format editing — tiered reveals, atmospheric sound design, long-form retention structure.
- [True Crime Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/true-crime-video-editing.html): True crime channel editing — tension pacing, evidence graphics, atmospheric grading.
- [VSL Video Editing](https://zeekayeditz.com/vsl-video-editing.html): Video sales letter editing for direct-response clients — filter hooks, claim-synced proof, pattern interrupts, conversion-focused CTA design.
